1924, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 6 Cont.
Febr 28 Cured from Drinking - Martin Lynch 2200 Chatterton Ave. Bronx Enrolled Dec. 22, then drinking heavily and without stop. - foreman - brick-layer - wife's heart broken: reported Today as "Doing ideally since beginning of January.
April 20th II. same benefactor - Tertiary Ragan from Union Port - Enrolls a second case, a certain John J. Finn of 94 South St. Jersey City, business man, losing Everything. April 20 same John J. Finn re- ported: "Went to holy Sacraments, shortly after Enrollment and model Holy Name Man since.
April 20 III. Today (April 20th) Same Ragan enrolles a third such case. This time a proficient Electrician.
Feb. 29th Frank boyle 1681 Lexington Ave. Auto-accident three years ago now in insane hospital
March 6th Mrs. Mary Toal of 156-E. 97th St. Enrolled for one year Febr. 19th. Burned by excessive Ex-ray two years ago - for ulserous carabuncle - very nervous and discouraged. To-day reported as quite improved with defective foot natural color. Consideration had been entertain- ed of prosecuting hospital authorities. Now everything dropped. Mrs. Toal is about 65 years old.
March 9th Charles A. Cook of 375-W. 126th St. Enrolled To-day against exces- sive drink - not to Sacraments in 4 yrs. May 11 reported Charles stopped drinking following week --
March 10 Ellen Reilly Stephens 2022-3rd Ave. Married two weeks ago in City Hall, refuses to have marriage fixed up. Mother's heart broken, family upset; sister in anxiety enrolls pair Today March 12 they come to monastery of own accord at 8:45P.M. and make all arrange- ments for and promises for dispensation and are married cannoni- cally shortly after. - April 2nd Deo Gratias
Page 7 March 16 Pedler gives up Drink - Starts managing Store. Emil (Convert) of Manhassett L.I. Enrolled January 6th peddling every day and drink- ing everythin. This was Sunday - following Thursday got steady work in a store - stopped drinking and now has been managing the business for over a month.
March 16 Walter L. Daly (Astoria, 40 Hallet St.) Enrolled against drink, etc.
March 17 Mrs. Anna Getz - widow having rooms to rent - paing $95 per month - complains cannot get along well - joined S.M.A. Today.
